posts.text:
Agentic AI systems can perceive and accomplish goals with minimal human oversight.

They have the potential to change society for the better – and for the worse.

It was a pleasure to join Agentic Futures Initiative’s inaugural policy symposium to discuss how we can embrace innovation without letting AI go completely off the rails.
posts.summary: Urges guardrails on agentic AI to prevent societal harms
